title: opuntia basilaris var. humistrata
intro: Opuntia basilaris var. humistrata, commonly known as Beavertail Prickly Pear, is a cactus species native to the southwestern United States. This plant is known for its edible fruits, pads, and flowers, which offer various health benefits. The health benefits of Beavertail Prickly Pear include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood sugar, and provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
